correctness.rationale: Acyclic vector fields on a tree are exactly matchings of its Hasse incidence graph. Removing all incidences at the common center gives a join of n copies of an edge disjoint from a vertex, an integral (n-1)-sphere with the sign action. Each central incidence has link with an inclusion homotopy-equivalent to that join. The relative cone quotient and integral long exact sequence give a surjective sign-twisted augmentation from Z^n to Z and kernel in degree n; all other groups vanish, including torsion. The independent finite Hasse-matching verifier reconstructed all faces, tested all 152 permutations of S2 through S5 by signed Lefschetz and computed all mod-two augmented Betti numbers for n=2,3,4.

value.rationale: The n-fold arm symmetry of a topological invariant is natural for an extended star. The exact integral Z[S_n] module, including its sign twist, is not determined by the existing n-1-dimensional Betti number. The result gives a complete infinite-family representation and fixed-vector criterion, with a canonical equivariant connecting homomorphism that explains the structure; it is neither a simple known-table rank recomputation nor an arbitrary finite slice.
